purpose: PR43 QRS-coupled secondary T migration; explicit benchmark baseline amendment, not a clinical acceptance threshold

baselineAmendment.reason: The clean LBBB and PVC teaching sources intentionally changed because secondary T is now derived from the final ventricular activation. Future noise-stress runs compare against this amended source state instead of permanently exempting those presets.

invariants: future clean sources must remain byte-identical to the amended baseline unless a new explicit amendment is reviewed
scope: The amended baseline incorporates the intentional secondary-T migration for LBBB and the ventricular ectopy source represented by PVC in the noise benchmark.
